Two quick options I can do right now:
1) Manually create a calendar invite for Wed 14 Oct at 16:00 BST (explicitly labeled in the subject) and send the .ics; or
2) Try booking via our Chili Piper widget (some customers have found it respects the browser timezone more reliably).

If you're happy with 16:00 BST on Wed 14th, I'll send a manual invite with the timezone in the subject and a Teams link. If you'd rather use Chili Piper, I can send that link instead.

Apologies for the friction — appreciate the patience.
